Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Introduction For and on behalf of Food Corporation of India, Headquarters, New Delhi, BID under two packet system (Technical Bid and Financial Bi d) are invited through GEM Portal for “Supply and Maintenance of I ndoor/Outdoor and Seasonal Plants”. The Bid will comprise of follo wing works: Supply of potted plants (Indoor/Outdoor/Flower/Seasonal Plants) al ong with trays, moss stick (where required) & their maintenance an d one gardener at the FCI premises on regular basis for maintenan ce and care of all plants. Scope of Work Subject as hereinafter mentioned, the Corporation does not guaran tee any definite volume of work. The Corporation has the right to v ary the requirement from time to time. At present the requirement is supply of 500 potted plants (Indoor/Outdoor/ Flower/seasonal pla nts) along with trays, moss stick (where required) & their maintena nce. 1. The Tenderer should provide/depute at least one gardener at the F CI premises on regular basis for maintenance and care of all plants on his own cost. Working hours of gardener will be from 9 AM to 5.

30 PM from Monday to Saturday. No payment would be made by F CI against the deployment of gardener. 2. The supply of potted plants along with trays, moss stick (as and w hen required) should be completed within one week form the date of awarding of the contract and maintenance work should be starte d simultaneously. 3. The contractor agency will have to supply healthy indoor variety of plants in plastic pots. All potted plants should be replaced every m onth at the cost of the agency. However, plants/ flowers which go d ry/sick/unhealthy shall be replaced as and when required, which wil l be informed by the officer/ official so authorized by “Competent A uthority”. 4. The Contractor should paint the old pots or the pots that required some beautification time to time to maintain the glorification of the office. 5. The contractor has to provide indoor/outdoor potted plants of type as required by the General Manager (Hqrs.) and/or any other perso n authorized and acting on his behalf and replacement according t o requirement would be conveyed to the contractor during the peri od of contract and the replacement shall be provided as and when required. 6. The office/Department has the sole right to select the required ind oor/outdoor potted plants/ or ask for plant replacement at any stag es of agreement. 7. A random check will be conducted to inspect the freshness, qualit y and quantity or otherwise of the indoor/outdoor potted plants. Th e decision of the Department in this regard will be binding on the a gency/ contractor. 8. The agency will maintain on daily basis all the plants by watering, cleaning, pruning, trenching, spraying of insecticides etc., by puttin g manure and filling moss grass or whatever needed in order to re move the mosquitos and insects within the pots which would maint ain the decent look of the potted plants. This daily exercise will hav e to be done by the agency before 11 AM. The gardeners allotted f or this purpose shall carry an identity card issued by the contractor and shall follow the security norms of the building. Such gardeners shall be well mannered, of good character, have police verification and should comply with the directions of the officer / official assign ed for the said work and other officers. 9. Provision of vertical gardening at the office entrance gate will be d one by the Contractor. 10. At time of requirement/ necessity Variety of Plant, Height & width of plant/pot, Material & Type of Pot can be varying from the desired

specification. Vendor has to supply as per requirement without add ing any extra cost. The contractor will ensure that the items supplied should be to the satisfaction of the General Manager (Hqrs.) and/or any other perso n authorized and acting on his behalf. The cost of all material, cartage, conveyance charges (from nurser y to office and vice versa), labour, tools, plants and equipment etc. shall be borne by the contractor. Further, any damages or loss caus ed during the transit will have to be borne by the contractor. The c ontractor shall provide services of at least one trained gardener on daily basis for up keeping of plants and wages / hiring cost of such gardeners has to be borne by the contractor. The contractor shall h ave no right to claim any cost/damage/loss due to theft or fire etc. In the event of any exigencies, the Department shall have discretio n to ask for more indoor/outdoor potted plants or flower plants on u rgent basis as per the rate approved.
